main.description: Destroy a group: remove it from the group service (credentials, member index, and per-group database). Lossy and irreversible — the audit log and record-authorship table are deleted. The underlying PDS account is left untouched (not account deletion): the account can be re-imported later, but the re-imported group loses its prior authorship and audit history. Requires the owner role.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the target group. Passed on the querystring (destroy takes no request body). Optional during the #27 deprecation window: omit it and the group is taken from the (deprecated) JWT aud claim instead.
